decision.observation: 0 mph, gear 1, timer 10:38.339, all dots pale. The car is stalled on the grass a couple of metres left of the gravel, nose up-frame; the road runs up-frame then curves left around the barrel-lined corner.
decision.hypothesis: The W+D hold from gear R shifted to gear 1 but killed all momentum, leaving the car stopped. Plain throttle from 0 has always restarted the car cleanly, so W alone first, then steer once rolling.
decision.memory: Changing from R to 1 with a steering hold loses all speed; from reverse, press plain W first to get rolling, and only steer after gear 1 has speed.
